The [[Hierophant's Chest]] will spawn after defeating [[Duncan the Black]] in the final level of the [[Slavers' Exile]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one [[Deldrimor Armor Remnant]], one [[Onyx Gemstone]] and one random item from the drop list below (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by all party members, a three minute countdown timer will begin, after which players will be transported out of the dungeon.
